2026-11-16 16:15 KSTDev log

Six AI rivals in two leagues

Build 5 added six AI rivals split into two leagues, a way to pick your opponent, and difficulty checked with simulated matches.

In short: Claimball has six AI rivals split into two leagues, each playing a little differently, and you choose who to face. Beat a rival to unlock the next, and your progress is saved. Difficulty is checked with simulated matches, and it is still being tuned with testers. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android.

Build 5, a TestFlight internal test build, gave Claimball someone to play against. It is not released to the public yet.

Six rivals, two leagues

There are six AI rivals, split into two leagues. Each one plays a little differently, from a gentle first opponent to a sharp last one.

Pick your opponent

You choose who to face. Beat a rival to unlock the next, and your progress is saved. Each rival's card shows your best stars against them.

Checked with simulated matches

To keep the ladder fair, we run many simulated matches between a plain test bot and each rival and compare how often the rival wins. One rival turned out to be a much bigger jump than the others, so we eased it. The same simulations also confirm that the landing marker matches where the ball really lands.

Still in tuning

These results come from bots, not from people. How the ladder feels in real hands is something we are still learning from testers.

What is next

Claimball is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android. There is no release date yet.

FAQ

How many rivals are there?

There are six AI rivals, split into two leagues. Each one plays a little differently, from a gentle first opponent to a sharp last one.

How do I unlock the next rival?

You choose who to face. Beat a rival to unlock the next, and your progress is saved. Each rival's card shows your best stars against them.

How is the difficulty checked?

We run many simulated matches between a plain test bot and each rival and compare how often the rival wins. One rival was a much bigger jump than the others, so we eased it. These results come from bots, not people, so we are still learning from testers.

Is Claimball released yet?

Not yet. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android, and there is no release date yet.

About the game: Claimball is a casual duel game on a notebook grid for iOS and Android (coming soon, not yet released).
